en: Stop scanning skills and plugins when the window gains focus. Scheduled refresh and manual Check & sync remain available.
Reuse the completed capability scan when updating the interface instead of scanning the same files again.
Reuse rendered conversation history while streaming replies or typing. New messages, task state and language changes still update normally. Large histories still require an initial read.
zh: 切回窗口时不再扫描技能和插件，保留定时刷新及手动“检查与同步”。
更新共享能力界面时复用刚完成的扫描结果，避免再次扫描相同文件。
流式回复及输入文字时复用已渲染的对话历史；新增消息、任务状态及语言变化仍正常更新。较大的历史记录首次打开仍需读取。
